critique: The render retains the expected black field, mint-white luminous line strings, particle-dot trails, and clear geometric change between t1 and t4. However, it still reads as a set of oversized intersecting ribbons rather than a coherent paired Horns structure. Major line bundles are clipped at every frame edge, and the center/upper-left crossings become dense bright bands that hide the individual string detail. Motion is evident, but it shifts the same cropped composition instead of keeping the horn-like forms legible in frame.

suggestions.why: Reduce the excessive horizontal span so the principal line bundles can be seen as complete curved horn forms rather than entering and exiting the frame as clipped ribbons.
Reduce the depth extent along with width to lessen the large projected crossings and make the paired structure read more cleanly through its motion.
Lower string density to preserve separated luminous strands at intersections and prevent the current broad, nearly solid white overlap bands.
